sdc.daemon.EventKind.title: EventKind
sdc.daemon.EventKind.description: Open text: the kind of the runtime's run-log line, copied. Events the daemon writes itself have a kind that starts with `runbook.`, and the command that writes each one declares it: runbook.submitted (SubmitRun), runbook.cancel-requested (CancelRun), runbook.start-failed (FailRunStart), runbook.run-orphaned (EndOrphanedRun), runbook.answer-undeliverable (AnswerDecision) and runbook.runtime-failed (written by the daemon just before it issues EndRun with the outcome runtime-failure), runbook.step-failed (written by the daemon just before it issues EndRun with the outcome `failed: step <action> <end>` (`<end>`: `exit <n>`, `signal <n>`, `timed out after <s> s` or `ended with no exit`), when the last program of the run's tree failed (it ended with an exit other than 0, was killed at its timeout or ended with no exit status, or Loom refused it for an exit its `exits.error` lists or a signal, an agent node (`sdc-node`) or any other program) and the tree has no other action to take; record: case, action, end, exit, signal and timeout_seconds (each of the last three when it applies), reason) and runbook.action-started (written by the daemon when the runtime tells that a program of an action, or its `handoff_when` check, is about to start, before the program starts; record: case, action, role (`program` or `check`) and try, each absent when unknown; the language cannot write a RunEvent from a command, so it is stated here, and the view RunDetail shows the step while the program runs). Not a closed set for the runtime's own kinds.
